summary: Who gets on the stage: You paid for the debate and brought the other candidates, and {moderator} orders your microphone cut.
realLife: Before the 1980 New Hampshire primary he paid for a debate a Nashua paper set up with George H. W. Bush and invited the other candidates. Bush refused to debate with them, the moderator ordered Reagan's microphone cut, and Reagan said he was paying for it. He won the primary easily.
gates: A debate on the calendar that your campaign paid for.
weights: How far ahead or behind you are.
choices: insist you are paying for it
go along with the two-person format
walk off with the candidates who were left out

branches.when: you are the one left out
branches.then: You stand at the edge of the stage, and leaving quietly or speaking up is the scene.

branches.when: {rival} refuses to go on with the others
branches.then: {rival} looks small or principled, by the room.
